upstreams.name: Sloop
upstreams.role: FM-1 firmware: sloop-fm1/ is upstream plus one patch (integrations/sloop-fm1/)

upstreams.name: ESP-IDF
upstreams.role: ESP32-S3 framework the slot firmwares build with

synths.name: Clipper
synths.summary: 23 engines from virtual analog to FM, physical models, grains and samples; 8 shared voices, arpeggiator and effects.
synths.hardware: Heard on the FM-1: clean notes.

synths.name: Melodee
synths.summary: Prophet (5 voices, 200 factory programs), FM6 (16 voices), CZ-1 (64 timbres), SID and DRUM 808/909/SID, with a shared effect rack (reverb, drive, crush, flanger, phaser, chorus).
synths.hardware: Flashed and read back; not heard yet.

synths.name: Felucca
synths.summary: 13 engines: ANALOG, FM6, PHASE, LOFI, SAMPLE, VOICE, TRIO, WHEEL, GRAIN, PHYS, NOISE, SLICE and DRUM; 8 shared voices.
synths.hardware: Flashed and read back; not heard yet.

synths.name: X0X
synths.summary: Circuit-modelled 909 and 808 (11 voices each) and two 303s (Open303, Devilfish mods, RAT drive) played by Sloop's sequencer.
synths.notes: Felucca fork with a host build; standalone dsp/ APIs (6.4k lines). Leave out seq/, the UI and dsp/breaks* (unlicensed source).

synths.name: AMY
synths.summary: 128 Juno-60 patches, DX7 patches, a partials piano, PCM drums and Karplus-Strong; officially supports the ESP32-S3.
synths.notes: Not an FM-1 firmware: one-line change to render on one core, and the parameter catalogue written by hand.

synths.name: Gator (Plaits)
synths.summary: Unmodified Mutable Instruments Plaits, 24 models: speech, modal, strings, particles, chords, 6-op FM.
synths.notes: Host build (host/sim.c); two documented changes. The DSP is MIT and can be vendored from pichenettes/eurorack directly. Monophonic.

synths.name: CTL-1 (GM sounds)
synths.summary: General MIDI ROMpler (Sonivox EAS, 200 KB sound set): pianos, electric pianos, strings, brass, guitars, GM drums.
synths.notes: fm1-base app with a host build; EAS has a C API (Apache-2.0). Renders at 22.05 kHz, doubled.

synths.name: Elixir
synths.summary: LXR-02 digital drum voices (6) plus Plaits and Rings drum models.
synths.notes: Felucca HAL, host comparison test against an LXR reference; voices coupled to its sequencer.

synths.name: Optimist
synths.summary: Up to 28 engines; new here: JUNO (KR-106 model), CS80, DRONE, STRETCH (PaulStretch), SUPER.
synths.notes: Has tests/hostsim.c and per-engine flash/RAM in its builder profiles; early access and fast-moving: cherry-pick engines.

synths.name: Jangada
synths.summary: ROBO (VOSIM, GENDYN, Walsh, scanned synthesis), DRONE, SUPER (6x superwave with ladder) and grit effects.
synths.notes: Felucca 1.x fork, same closure as the Felucca port. Do not import its sample-pack assets.

synths.name: Lunar Modulator (Braids)
synths.summary: Engine zoo: Braids' 47 shapes, Plaits models, msfa DX7, 303/909/808.
synths.notes: Plain C99 engine API with a render CLI; C++ Mutable code; never run on an FM-1. GPL modules behind FM1_GPL_MODS.

synths.name: Hortator
synths.summary: About 22 drum models (Plaits drum ports), a resonator and a compressor.
synths.notes: Felucca fork with tests/drumsim.c; BLE and 8-track code tangled in. Overlaps X0X and Elixir.

synths.name: Fantasma
synths.summary: AMBI textures (sea, rain, vinyl, endless noise), BELL and a ~90 s reverb.
synths.notes: Felucca 1.6 fork; 266 lines of new DSP.

synths.name: DUELL
synths.summary: Morphing bi-timbral synth: MORPH, twin filter, six reverbs, user wavetables.
synths.notes: Two-part design with the second part on the FM-1's second core (one-core fallback exists).
